dogecoin.text: It is one thing a payment network (#xrp ) or “world computer” (#eth ) having a run at it’s market cap but another money doing it (#Dogecoin) invalidates pretty much everything Bitcoin stands for

As someone who has left Bitcoin due to it’s toxicity if the community agreed to updates like these I would be excited about Bitcoin again. I do think it would need to be flippened by #Eth and afraid of #Dogecoin (not as crazy as you think) to get community to change attitude
